note: pe58 external conversion constants (factor intervals, unsigned: compared with f and 1/f). Measured outside any cuneiform or PE corpus, except U* rows, which are Ur III ladders measured by pe58 itself from CDLI distributive lines (modal rate per person, words visible) and are used only as the CONTROL truth, not as PE constants.

barley_to_groats_mass.src: FAO Technical Conversion Factors for Agricultural Commodities (1996), barley groats/whole seed except hulls, extraction 65% (60-70); https://www.fao.org/4/x9892e/X9892e03.htm

barley_to_malt_mass.src: malting loss 15-25% of dry mass (steeping, respiration, rootlet removal); standard malting technology figure

flour_to_bread_mass.src: baking yield (dough water minus bake loss), standard bakery figure

grain_to_beer_volume.src: traditional cereal beers, 1 volume of grain to 2-4 volumes of beer (wide; ethnographic sorghum/millet beers)

greasy_to_clean_wool.src: scouring yield of coarse/carpet wools (IWTO yield range)

man_to_woman_energy.src: FAO/WHO/UNU 2004 Human energy requirements, adults moderate activity (~2900 vs ~2200 kcal/d); https://www.fao.org/4/y5686e/y5686e00.htm

man_to_child5_10_energy.src: FAO/WHO/UNU 2004 children 5-10 y (~1400-1900 kcal/d) vs adult man

man_to_toddler_energy.src: FAO/WHO/UNU 2004 ages 1-2 (850-950 kcal/d) vs adult man

ewe_to_weaned_lamb_mass.src: fat-tailed / Awassi-type ewes 40-55 kg vs weaned lambs 12-20 kg (animal science standard ranges)

ram_to_ewe_mass.src: sexual dimorphism of Near Eastern sheep breeds

cattle_to_sheep_livestock_unit.src: Tropical Livestock Unit (Jahnke 1982): cattle 0.7, sheep/goat 0.1; feed-intake ratios 5-8
